title: SMTP session state machine prevents command sequencing attacks
description: smtp/src/session.rs:74-80: SessionState enum (Fresh → Greeted → Mail → Rcpt) with exhaustive checks before each command handler. MAIL only accepted in Greeted state, DATA only after RCPT. A contributor might suggest removing state checks for 'simplicity' since 'real MTAs handle this anyway' — resist this. The state machine is the first defense against envelope injection and confused deputy attacks; it is cheap to maintain and catches protocol violations before any storage writes.
